userReq: Create a short demo video of trypitch.co showing: the homepage hero section, then navigate to the pricing page to see the Starter/Pro/Enterprise plans, and finally the About Us page to see their mission and vision.

steps.description: Land on the homepage and show the hero section with the 'Lights. Script. Render.' tagline and the sample demo video
Click the Pricing link in the footer navigation to go to the pricing page
Show the pricing page with tabs for Monthly Subscriptions and One-time Top-ups, Starter at $10/mo, Pro at $40/mo, and Enterprise for custom volume
Click on the Pro plan 'Buy 50 Credits' button to highlight the best value plan
Click the About Us link in the footer to go to the About page
Show the About Us page with Our Mission, What We Do, and Our Vision sections
Conclude the demo — Pitch turns any URL into a cinematic product demo in minutes
